summary.business_type: Travel / informational content site about Chinese mountain destinations
top_findings: No robots.txt — search engines have no crawling instructions
Homepage missing H1 tag — primary heading absent from the most important page
No Open Graph or Twitter Card tags on any page — social sharing renders blank
Blog posts lack BlogPosting schema — missed rich-result opportunities
Sitemap missing lastmod/changefreq/priority — poor crawl optimization signals
quick_wins: Add robots.txt with sitemap reference (5 min)
Wrap homepage hero text in <h1> (15 min)
Add OG + Twitter Card meta tags to base layout (30 min)
Remove WebSite schema from non-homepage layouts (15 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 43 pages have correct canonical URLs
Sitemap covers 42 indexable URLs
Valid HTML5 across all pages
lang='en' consistently declared
No HTTP mixed content detected

findings.title: No robots.txt file
findings.description: No robots.txt exists in public/ or dist/. Every site needs one even if it allows all crawling. Without it, search engines have no crawl guidance.
findings.recommendation: Create public/robots.txt with User-agent: *, Allow: /, Sitemap: https://chinesemountains.org/sitemap-index.xml

findings.title: Sitemap missing lastmod/changefreq/priority
findings.description: All 42 sitemap entries lack lastmod, changefreq, and priority fields. These help engines prioritize crawl budget.
findings.recommendation: Configure @astrojs/sitemap to include lastmod based on content dates. Add changefreq and priority for key pages.

findings.title: 404 page has canonical URL and no noindex
findings.description: The 404 page includes a canonical to /404/ and has no meta robots noindex tag. Search engines may index it.
findings.recommendation: Add <meta name='robots' content='noindex'> to 404.astro and remove the canonical link.

findings.title: No security headers (deployment concern)
findings.description: As a static site, security headers depend on the CDN/host. Verify HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and X-Frame-Options are set.
findings.recommendation: Configure CDN to add Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Blog posts are well-researched, original, and practical (1,000-1,500 words)
Mountain detail pages are consistently thorough across all 25 peaks
Readability is excellent — short paragraphs, clear headings, bulleted lists
Domain expertise is evident — covers obscure peaks most travel sites miss
Guide pages are well-structured by season and target audience

findings.title: About page is thin content (~200 words)
findings.description: The /about/ page has only two paragraphs. A thin About page undermines E-E-A-T signals for the entire site.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 500-800 words covering mission, team, editorial standards, and sources. Add Organization schema.

findings.title: No author pages or individual bylines
findings.description: All content uses 'Chinese Mountains Team' as the byline with no individual attribution. This weakens authoritativeness.
findings.recommendation: Create individual author bios with real names and photos for blog posts.

findings.title: No privacy policy or contact page
findings.description: No privacy policy, terms, or contact page exists. These are trust signals Google considers for YMYL-adjacent content.
findings.recommendation: Add privacy policy and contact pages.

findings.title: Templated meta descriptions on mountain pages
findings.description: All 25 mountain pages use the pattern 'Everything about [Name]: height, trails, weather, photos, history, travel tips.'
findings.recommendation: Write unique value-proposition descriptions for each mountain.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All pages have descriptive meta descriptions
Internal linking is strong with contextual 'You May Also Like' sections
Navigation uses descriptive anchor text
Title tag pattern is clean and consistent
Comparison table on homepage provides deep internal links

findings.title: Homepage has no H1 tag
findings.description: The homepage hero text 'Discover Every Famous Peak in China' is in a <div>, not an <h1>. This is the single strongest on-page signal and it is entirely absent.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the hero title in <h1> with the existing classes applied.

findings.title: H1 text has leading/trailing whitespace on mountain pages
findings.description: All 25 mountain page H1 tags contain extra whitespace (e.g., ' Mount Huangshan '). This won't affect ranking but indicates a template spacing issue.
findings.recommendation: Trim whitespace in the Astro template that renders the H1.

findings.title: Redundant branding in title tags
findings.description: Some pages have doubled brand suffix: 'About | Chinese Mountains | Chinese Mountains'. The homepage says 'Chinese Mountains - ... | Chinese Mountains'.
findings.recommendation: Fix the template logic that appends the site name to title tags.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: TouristAttraction schema on mountain detail pages with geo, address, UNESCO data
FAQPage schema on homepage with 3 relevant questions
All JSON-LD blocks parse correctly
SearchAction schema enables sitelinks search box

findings.title: Blog posts lack BlogPosting schema
findings.description: All 3 blog posts only have the generic WebSite schema. No BlogPosting or Article schema is present, missing rich-result opportunities.
findings.recommendation: Add BlogPosting schema with headline, author, datePublished, dateModified, image, and description to each blog post template.

findings.title: WebSite schema duplicated on every page
findings.description: The WebSite + SearchAction schema block is in the shared layout and appears on all 43 pages including /404/. It should only be on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Move WebSite schema from the base layout to src/pages/index.astro only.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList schema
findings.description: Mountain and blog pages have visible breadcrumb navigation but no BreadcrumbList JSON-LD. This is a missed rich-result opportunity.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList schema to all pages with visible breadcrumbs.

findings.title: About page lacks Organization schema
findings.description: The About page has no structured data identifying the site as an Organization.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema to the About page with name, url, description, and sameAs links.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CSS is very lean at 33 KB
WebP format used for all mountain images
loading='lazy' applied to below-fold images
Astro static build produces efficient HTML output

findings.title: JavaScript payload is heavy for a content site
findings.description: 9 JS bundles total 403 KB for what is primarily a content and navigation site. The interactive map and quiz account for most of this.
findings.recommendation: Consider code-splitting or lazy-loading interactive components. The quiz and calendar don't need to load on every page.

findings.title: External render-blocking resources
findings.description: Google Fonts and Leaflet CSS are loaded from external CDNs in <head>, blocking first paint.
findings.recommendation: Self-host Geist font (already in node_modules). Inline or defer Leaflet CSS.

findings.title: hero-map-bg.png is PNG, not WebP
findings.description: The hero map background image is PNG format. Converting to WebP would save ~50%.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP and update the image reference.

findings.title: No responsive images (srcset)
findings.description: All images are served at a single resolution. Mobile users download the same 400+ KB images as desktop.
findings.recommendation: Add srcset with multiple resolutions or use Astro's built-in image optimization.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Content is structured and fact-dense, ideal for AI extraction
Schema markup helps AI understand entity relationships
Strong domain focus — clear what the site is about
Descriptive alt text feeds AI image understanding

findings.title: No Open Graph tags means blank AI previews
findings.description: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI platforms use OG tags to render shared link previews. Without them, all shares show blank cards.
findings.recommendation: Add full OG + Twitter Card tags to the base layout immediately.

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: No llms.txt provides a structured site overview for LLM crawlers. This is increasingly important for AI citability.
findings.recommendation: Create public/llms.txt with site description and key page URLs.

findings.title: Lack of author attribution hurts AI citation trust
findings.description: AI models weigh named authorship when deciding whether to cite content. 'Chinese Mountains Team' is anonymous.
findings.recommendation: Add named author bios with credentials to blog posts and key reference pages.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images have descriptive, keyword-rich alt text
WebP format used throughout (except hero-map-bg.png)
Alt text is specific and contextual (not generic)

findings.title: Total image payload is 8 MB
findings.description: 26 images total 8.02 MB. Several mountain photos exceed 400 KB each.
findings.recommendation: Apply more aggressive WebP compression. Consider 250 KB as a ceiling for hero images.

findings.title: Missing explicit width/height on img tags
findings.description: Many img tags lack explicit width and height attributes, relying only on CSS for sizing. This causes layout shift (CLS).
findings.recommendation: Add width and height attributes to all img tags, matching the aspect ratio.

findings.title: No responsive image strategy
findings.description: No srcset, no picture elements, no multiple resolutions. Mobile users download full-size images.
findings.recommendation: Implement responsive images via Astro's Image component or manual srcset.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add H1 to homepage hero section
Add Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags to base layout
Remove WebSite schema from non-homepage layouts
Generate default OG social share image

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add BlogPosting schema to all blog posts
Add BreadcrumbList schema to pages with breadcrumbs
Fix H1 whitespace on mountain page templates

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google Search Console and submit sitemap
